🇲🇽🛢️ <u>Fuel-theft network ran through Navy brass and the airport</u>

The FGR says the “huachicol fiscal” fuel-smuggling ring led by ex-Navy brothers Roberto and Fernando Farías Laguna reached the customs house of Mexico City’s international airport and six seaports. Nineteen former Marines are implicated — an admiral, two rear admirals, two vice admirals and 14 captains — accused of faking import papers to dodge fuel taxes.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Mexico bets on public investment, not austerity</u>

While the neoliberal playbook demands cuts, Mexico is doing the opposite: Hacienda reports public physical investment surged in June as Sheinbaum's Plan México adds an extra 722 billion pesos to infrastructure this year — on top of the 900 billion already budgeted — with a roadmap to 5.6 trillion pesos across energy, trains, ports, water, health and education by 2030.

💵🇲🇽 <u>Trump tried to choke the remittances. They hit a record instead.</u>

Mexico pulled in $30.76 billion in remittances in the first half of 2026 — up 3.1% and the highest first half on record — even after Trump's May decree ordering US banks to police migrant transfers. The average transfer climbed 5% to $405, and Guanajuato, Michoacán and Jalisco alone took in $7.83 billion, per Banco de México data reported by El Economista.

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>Mexico is taking its energy back from the firms that carved it up</u>

Mexico is clawing back the energy sovereignty the neoliberals sold off: six refineries rehabilitated, the Dos Bocas refinery online, the Deer Park plant in Texas bought outright, and a target of 1.8 million barrels a day — cutting the gasoline-import dependence built up over decades. The transition to clean energy is being run through public Pemex and CFE, not handed to foreign companies.

💰🇲🇽 <u>CEPAL wants Mexicans to work longer for the same broken pension</u>

CEPAL's "fix" for Mexico's pensions is to tie the retirement age to life expectancy — make people work longer — while ignoring the actual wound: the 1997 switch from IMSS's solidarity system to private Afores. Those funds booked more than 500 billion pesos in losses this year alone, and workers once promised 70% of their final salary now retire on about 6,000 pesos a month. As Martín Esparza writes in Contralínea, the answer isn't raising the bar — it's restoring the old solidarity system.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>The receipts on who really ran Calderón's drug war</u>

Newly declassified US State Department and Embassy cables show Washington didn't just fund Felipe Calderón's drug war — it ran it. Contralínea documents DEA, CIA, FBI and ATF agents steering "operational, military and intelligence strategies" through the Mérida Initiative: a $2.5M polygraph program wired into CISEN, the SSP and the tax authority, 19 VACIS scanner trucks, and a 7,000 m² surveillance bunker with 600+ connection points inaugurated in 2009 by Genaro García Luna — the same official now serving a US prison sentence for working with the Sinaloa Cartel.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>Mexican unions are building a boycott wall around Israel</u>

A year after planting the "Door of Resistance and Life" antimonument in front of Mexico City's Hemiciclo a Juárez, activists, artists and unions returned to demand an end to the genocide in Gaza and to widen the economic boycott of companies "complicit and financing the death of thousands of Palestinians." The push runs through the electricians' union SME, the teachers' CNTE and a new Latin American Network for Palestine that has drawn 300+ organizations behind BDS.

🏥🇲🇽 <u>Mexico's public health system is pulling patients back from the private sector</u>

Mexico's public health system logged 29.8 million general consultations through 2026 — up 50% from 2023 — with specialty care up 90% inside IMSS-Bienestar and 32 new hospitals built, 39 by year's end. Sheinbaum's read: instead of going to private care and waiting with long delays, people are now being served in the public system.

🇲🇽🎨 "Let music, culture, art, sport and love be part of life — not violence." Sheinbaum announced the finalists of México Canta, a binational song contest for Mexican youth on both sides of the border. — Claudia Sheinbaum, México Canta The contest lifts identity, belonging and peace over narco-corridos and addiction. Finalists span both countries — from Tamaulipas and Jalisco to Chicago and the Bronx. Culture as a security strategy.

🔥🇲🇽 García Luna’s stolen millions will now build schools in Guerrero’s mountains. "So far 5.8 million dollars have been recovered. Our goal is that this money go to schools in the Montaña of Guerrero." — Claudia Sheinbaum On Aug 25 Mexico received $5,805,693 from a bond and the liquidation of 12 Florida properties tied to the García Luna–Weinberg network. The neoliberal era’s top cop — convicted in a US court — now pays for classrooms in the country’s poorest region.
